segments.text: V. 40, 41. Where the Damage is not great, chuſe rather to ſuffer it, tho' poſſibly it may on that account be repeated, than to demand an eye for an eye, to enter into a rigorous Proſecution of the Offender. The Meaning of the whole Paſſage ſeems to be, Rather than return Evil for Evil when the Wrong is purely perſonal, ſubmit to one bodily Wrong after another, give up one Part of your Goods after another, ſubmit to one Inſtance of Compulſion after another. That the Words are not literally to be underſtood, appears from the Behaviour of our LORD himſelf, John xviii. 22, 23.
